name: Scenario AR: Vehicle Status Update
comments: Triggered by a HubSpot webhook when a deal's vehicle_status property changes to: ready, in_progress, or waiting_parts. Fetches the full deal and associated contact from HubSpot. Claude generates a status-appropriate email (ready=pickup notification, in_progress=work update, waiting_parts=delay notice). Sends via Resend from client domain. Logs a HubSpot note. Error route sends an internal alert via Resend. All secrets stored as env.VARIABLE_NAME. Timezone: America/New_York.

metadata.notes: Receives HubSpot deal.propertyChange webhooks. Filter passes only changes to vehicle_status with values ready, in_progress, or waiting_parts. Register this webhook URL in HubSpot > Settings > Integrations > Webhooks for deal.propertyChange events.
Fetches the full deal record including vehicle properties. objectId comes from the HubSpot webhook payload.

webhooks.name: HubSpot Deal Property Webhook (hook 3080)
webhooks.notes: Configure in HubSpot > Settings > Integrations > Webhooks. Subscribe to deal.propertyChange for the vehicle_status property. Make generates the real URL on import and activation.

RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS_CLIENT.label: Resend Client From Address
RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS_CLIENT.notes: Verified client shop domain sender. Never brian@cwiai.net.

notes.label: Module 1 — HubSpot Webhook + vehicle_status Filter
notes.note: Receives deal.propertyChange webhooks from HubSpot. Filter requires propertyName=vehicle_status AND propertyValue in (ready, in_progress, waiting_parts).

notes.label: Modules 2–4 — Fetch Deal + Contact
notes.note: Module 2 fetches the full deal (vehicle details). Module 3 gets associated contact IDs. Module 4 fetches the contact record (name, email, phone).

notes.label: Module 5 — Claude: Generate Status Email
notes.note: Single Claude call handles all three status types. System prompt branches behaviour: ready=pickup, in_progress=work update, waiting_parts=parts delay. Temperature 0.5 for natural but consistent tone.

notes.label: Module 6 — Resend: Customer Status Email
notes.note: Sends from env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS_CLIENT (client shop domain). Subject and header colour dynamically set: green for ready, blue for in_progress, orange for waiting_parts.

notes.label: Module 7 — HubSpot Note
notes.note: Logs the outbound email action on the deal for a complete audit trail.
